acceptanceCriteria.text: One command/function can review a fixed PR-revision fixture end to end from structured input to structured result.
Output validates against the review-result contract and is anchored to exact repository/PR/base/head identity.
Blocking findings include evidence references and source location when available.
Reviewer cannot silently expand into unbounded repository exploration.
Provider failures and malformed model output fail with bounded typed diagnostics.
Tests cover APPROVE, CHANGES_REQUIRED, INCONCLUSIVE, malformed output and provider failure using hermetic/fake provider fixtures.
No auto-fix, auto-merge or multi-agent critic architecture is introduced.

issue.title: feat: execute one autonomous AI review for an exact PR revision
